Q1.name: HAZARD_IDENTIFICATION_QUALITY
Q1.unit: cases meeting the standard / cases where a hazard is owed
Q1.basis: the twenty-four frozen cases intersected with the ten not withdrawn under invariant 25. Every one identified the materially relevant hazard the frozen truth names, and in no case did a materially irrelevant hazard dominate

Q2.name: DECLARATION_RECALL
Q2.basis: owed properties declared over owed properties, on the three owed-property cases not withdrawn. All three were emitted as structured declarations

Q3.name: DECLARATION_PRECISION
Q3.unit: declarations matching an owed property / declarations emitted
Q3.basis: declarations matching an owed property over declarations emitted, across the ten cases not withdrawn. Ten declarations were emitted and three match an owed property. Seven are manufactured, four of them on unknowns the frozen truth names as immaterial

Q4.name: EXACT_CONTROLLING_PROPERTY_IDENTITY
Q4.unit: declarations naming the controlling property / declarations matched to an owed property
Q4.basis: declarations naming the controlling property over declarations matched to an owed property. All three name the controlling proposition and none is an annotated prohibited proxy

Q5.name: CLARIFICATION_QUALITY
Q5.basis: adequate clarifications over clarifications expected. G3 demands an inspection for a bypass magnet where the frozen truth requires a functional test that proves the auger stops, which is evidence incapable of settling the property

Q6.name: IMMEDIATE_POSTURE_ACCURACY
Q6.basis: exact posture identities over admitted cases. Six exact. Four misses, every one of them OVER-conservative: G5 and M1 and M8 one rank above, C5 two ranks above. No admitted posture was under-conservative

Q7.name: POSTURE_BASIS_COHERENCE
Q7.unit: cases meeting the frozen role-presence expectation / admitted cases
Q7.basis: cases meeting the frozen role-presence expectation over admitted cases. Six fail, five of them by carrying a driver role the frozen expectation sets to NONE

Q8.name: CORRECTIVE_ACTION_AND_SEQUENCING_QUALITY
Q8.unit: adequate corrective directions / cases where one is expected
Q8.basis: adequate corrective directions over cases where one is expected, among cases not withdrawn. G5 and C5 emit no required control at all where the frozen truth requires controls during continued work

Q9.name: REGULATORY_GROUNDING_QUALITY
Q9.unit: correctly grounded cases / cases supplying an on-point record
Q9.basis: correctly grounded cases over cases supplying an on-point record, among cases not withdrawn. Only G3 survives; its single governed reference is the on-point record named by its exact sourceId, and the off-point record is never treated as authority

Q10.name: EXPLANATION_USEFULNESS
Q10.basis: useful explanations over cases analysed, among cases not withdrawn. Every explanation is faithful to its observation, states its basis in the model's own words and would help rather than mislead

Q11.name: REVIEWER_USABILITY
Q11.basis: usable packets over packets built. Three packets were built. Each presents the observation span, the proposed property, both branches and both decisions, and each is sufficient for a reviewer to answer the one question it asks. The separate question of whether the packet surfaces everything the frozen list names is HS14, which fires on G3 and C6; the two are scored independently and neither is allowed to stand in for the other

Q12.name: RESTRAINT
Q12.basis: restraint held over restraint opportunities, among cases not withdrawn. Held on G7, M3 and M7. Lost on G5, C5, M1 and M8, each by declaring an unknown the frozen truth names as immaterial, or a condition it records as adequately negated, as a decision-critical fact

Q13.name: STRUCTURAL_ADMISSION_RELIABILITY
Q13.unit: structurally clean and admitted calls / calls executed
Q13.basis: structurally clean and admitted calls over calls executed. Ten of twenty-four first-pass calls were admitted. Five of six verifier calls were clean; C2's verifier nominated outside its supplied target and the scope-containment layer refused it, which the frozen rule counts here. Every §239 refusal counts as a failure here including a correct fail-closed one

rules.why: G=0 AND (M>=1 OR I>=1 OR a disclosed limitation occurred materially)
